title: Auditing World-Model Explanations in Retail Forecasting: Faithfulness, Accuracy and Price Response
abstract: arXiv:2611.20811v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Forecasting models that read the price and promotion plan explain each forecast as a baseline, what would sell with nothing planned, plus the lift the plan adds. We test such explanations with eight checks, six with a pass rule fixed before any result, and find that passing them does not make an explanation right. In generated store data with known effects, a world model passes the checks of construction, stability, price direction and agreement with sales and with LightGBM, yet its lifts are 1.33 to 1.40 times the truth when merchants plan into high-demand weeks, and 1.23 to 1.42 times in eight variants of that world. It still picks the right weeks to promote, but stock ordered to its lift is off by 0.44 to 0.48 of the true lift. Its stated response to a lasting regular-price change is 4.7 to 6.5 times the true -0.5, and only a measured cause finds this. translated_title: 零售预测中世界模型解释的审计：忠实性、准确性与价格响应
translated_abstract: 能够读取价格与促销计划的预测模型，将每个预测解释为两部分之和：一个基线（即不执行任何计划时的销量），加上该计划带来的提升。我们通过八项检查来检验此类解释，其中六项在任何结果出现之前就已固定了通过规则，结果发现通过这些检查并不意味着解释是正确的。在效应已知的人工生成门店数据中，一个世界模型通过了构造性、稳定性、价格方向以及与销量和LightGBM一致性等各项检查，但当商家将促销计划安排在高需求周时，其提升值是真实值的1.33至1.40倍；在该世界的八种变体中，这一比例为1.23至1.42倍。它仍然能选对促销的周次，但根据其提升值订购的库存与真实提升值相比偏差达0.44至0.48。它所宣称的对长期常规价格变动的响应是真实值-0.5的4.7至6.5倍，而只有通过实际测量才能发现这一点。在Dominick's数据集上，38个门店常规价格偏离其z（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 研究发现，零售预测中的世界模型解释即使通过了八项审计检查（如构造性、稳定性、价格方向和与真实销量的一致性），其促销提升估计仍可能高出真实值1.2至1.4倍，价格响应被夸大近5至6.5倍，表明通过常规检查并不保证解释的忠实性与准确性。
en_tdlr: World-model explanations in retail forecasting can pass all eight audit checks—yet still overstate promotional lifts by 1.2-1.4x and inflate price responses by roughly 5-6.5x—demonstrating that passing conventional checks does not make an explanation faithful or accurate.
